Meet Coach Daniel (@dj_gutierrez99) of The Facility (@thefacility.bayarea)

The Facility is a welcoming space for everyone, no matter your fitness background or experience. We take pride in fostering a diverse and inclusive community where individuals of all levels can come together to work toward their goals. Meet Coach Starr (@fitwithstarr) of FitStarr Studio (@fitstarrstudio) 

After years of hard work, faith, and vision — FITSTARR: Born to Shine is officially coming to life

This isn’t just a gym — it’s a movement. A space built for strength, mobility, recovery, and community, where people can grow physically and mentally and truly shine.

Every contribution goes directly toward their build-out — mirrors, flooring, turf, lighting, and final details that will make FITSTARR feel like home.

Meet Coach Leah (@leah.galarza) of Strong Babes (@heystrongbabe)

Coach Leah believes in faith and fitness go hand in hand. Leah is a strong Christian so God is in the center of all that she does. Fitness is a tool to help us live responsibly so we can thrive and be truly healthy in all that we feel called to do in our lives. Her mission in life is to be bold, authentic, and grateful in all that she does and inspire others to do the same so that we all can live passionate, full, blessed lives that align with our purpose and true identity.

Meet our Inessence Salsa Dance instructors of Inessence Dance (@inessencedanceco)

Inessence Dance Company directors Bryon Stroud and Sammantha Arias first joined forces in 2012. 

Now, their once-small group of local bachata dancers has expanded to become an organization of 100+ across the Bay Area, Sacramento, and now Concord,CA. Inessence provides dance lessons,dance events,dance teams, and entertainment.
